page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Review rules your agents add to their prompt. Link a skill to an agent in the agent's Skills tab.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a set of review rules in markdown. Create one, then link it to an agent.

card.toggle: Enable {name} for every agent that links it

preview.usedByNone: Not linked to any agent yet.
preview.untrustedNotice: Imported from outside this workspace. It reaches the prompt only as untrusted data: the model may apply its criteria, but it cannot change the reviewer's role, output or findings.
preview.deleteConfirm: Delete skill “{name}”? It is removed from all agents. This can't be undone.

editor.name: Name
editor.nameHint: kebab-case: a–z, 0–9 and “-”, up to 64 characters. Shown in the run trace.
editor.descriptionHint: Write it as a directive — what the reviewer must do, e.g. “Flag any hard-coded secret, token or private key added in the diff.” It is sent to the model as the first line of the skill.
editor.enabledHint: Whether this skill is added to the prompts of the agents that link it.
editor.bodyHint: Markdown rules, sent to the model right after the description.

errors.nameFormat: Use a kebab-case slug: a–z, 0–9 and “-”, starting with a letter or digit, up to 64 characters.
errors.nameTaken: A skill with this name already exists.
errors.descriptionTooLong: Keep the description under {max, number} characters.
errors.bodyTooLong: Keep the body under {max, number} characters.
